items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's a quote a few years ago, not very long, Bill did an album for Sonny Stitt--have you heard it, the Sonny Stitt Plays Ellington album? [INTERVIEWEE] No, but I remember Bill doing that.

ctx.x: So eventually it was released, and when it was released the disc jockeys picked right up on it and we became one of the proverbial "overnight things", which I wish hadn't happened, because it put us out on the road, where we immediately began to lose money that we didn't have in the first place. Although we waited a year to do it.
There's a quote a few years ago, not very long, Bill did an album for Sonny Stitt--have you heard it, the Sonny Stitt Plays Ellington album?
No, but I remember Bill doing that.
